summary.text: Kenneth Casner, a Democratic candidate who listed an Elk Mountain address, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Governor of Wyoming to Eric Barlow.
He previously ran for governor in 2002 and 2018.
He did not respond to WyoFile's candidate questionnaire, and little public information about his platform was found.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Casner also ran for governor in 2002 and 2018.
In 2026 he won the Democratic primary without opposition, receiving 10,706 votes.
He did not answer any of the questions in WyoFile's candidate questionnaire, and state filings as of August 17, 2026 showed no money raised or spent by his campaign.
He received 14.7% of the vote to Eric Barlow's 68.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
